notes: Five reusable creative archetypes for RistHome. Each one fixes the hook type, the narrative beats, the format recipe used by scripts/new-post.ts, the platform adaptations, the quality gates and the KPIs to read. Hypotheses are templates: a brief must make them concrete and measurable.

archetypes.name: Process reveal (ingredient to dish)
archetypes.useFor: Cooking classes; any dish with a visible technique (mortar, rolling pasta, frying, filling cannoli).
archetypes.hookType: Hands at work + explicit promise in the first second ('Cook Sicilian pasta with a chef in Palermo').
narrative: 3 to 5 numbered steps from raw to plated

platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: 9:16, 18-25 s, text inside the safe area, cover frame = hook frame.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: same cut; add native captions and a trending sound inside the app; never upload music files you do not own.
platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5, 6-8 slides, one dish per slide, text slide before the CTA.

qualityGates: real RistHome photos only
texts describe what the photo shows
headline >= 84 px, support >= 44 px on 1080 px width
no guest faces without written consent
no price claims unless confirmed by the chef
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: American travellers who want to do something with their hands in Sicily, not only see it
briefDefaults.objective: Cooking-class bookings on risthome.it or GetYourGuide
briefDefaults.hook: A feeling, not a service: for example "Don't just visit Sicily. Learn to make it." The hands or the chef first.
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A step-by-step process reel keeps viewers longer than a plate montage. Success: average watch time >= 60% of length.

archetypes.name: Chef at work (behind the scenes)
archetypes.useFor: Short, fast reels built from action frames: flame, pouring, plating, pasta lifted from the pot.
archetypes.hookType: Action frame with a crash zoom; one short line that names the moment ('3 seconds before service').
narrative: 4-6 fast cuts of the chef working

platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: 9:16, 10-15 s, cuts on the beat if music is added in-app.
platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: not recommended; use a single photo post with the plated result instead.

qualityGates: chef only, or guests with consent
no blurry hook frame
labels optional, keep text under 6 words per scene
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: Food lovers in Sicily and Italian-speaking locals who follow chefs
briefDefaults.hook: The most dynamic frame with a crash zoom
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: Fast behind-the-scenes cuts earn more shares than plated montages. Success: share rate >= 1% of plays.

archetypes.retired: 2026-11-11: the owner discarded this style; replaced by the pieces in the manner of A7

archetypes.name: Menu list (N things you will eat or cook)
archetypes.useFor: Carousels that name dishes one by one: class menus, event finger food, seasonal menus.
archetypes.hookType: Numbered promise on the cover ('6 finger foods for your event').
narrative: one dish per slide, name + one factual line

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5, 7-9 slides, the cover must work alone in the feed.
platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: optional cut: same slides as 2 s scenes with numbers as labels.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: photo-mode post with the same slides.

qualityGates: every dish name matches the photo
no more than 220 characters per slide body
page indicator on every inner slide
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: People planning an event or a class who compare options and save posts
briefDefaults.hook: A numbered promise over a real tray
briefDefaults.cta: Ask for a proposal on risthome.it
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A list carousel earns more saves than a single photo. Success: save rate >= 2% of reach.

archetypes.name: Private table (place, mise en place, courses)
archetypes.useFor: Private chef at home, villa dinners, boats: sell the setting before the food.
archetypes.hookType: The setting first (garden, terrace, laid table) + 'a chef cooks at your place'.

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; the text slide states what is included (shopping, cooking, service, cleanup).
platformAdaptations.tiktok: same cut; captions in English for tourists.

qualityGates: the setting shown is a real RistHome service
courses named only when the photo shows them
the 24-hour quote promise must stay true operationally
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: American couples, families and small groups planning Sicily, and guests of villas around Palermo
briefDefaults.hook: A feeling, not a service: for example "You came to Sicily for the food. Make it personal." The setting or the table first.
briefDefaults.cta: Write to us on risthome.it, quote within 24 hours
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: Showing the setting before the plates raises quote requests. Success: >= 2 qualified requests per 1,000 plays.

archetypes.retired: 2026-11-11: the owner discarded this style; replaced by the pieces in the manner of A7

archetypes.name: Proof and offer (social proof, seasonal offer, gift)
archetypes.useFor: Christmas gift vouchers, seasonal menus, review highlights, milestone posts.
archetypes.hookType: A verified number or quote ('5.0 on Google, 101 reviews') or a dated offer.
narrative: hook: the proof or the offer
CTA with a deadline or a link

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; the proof slide quotes a real review verbatim with the reviewer's first name only.
platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: optional; use when the offer has a deadline.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: rarely; offers convert better on Instagram for this brand.

qualityGates: numbers and quotes verified on the platform the day of posting
offers approved by the chef with price and validity
no AI-generated testimonials
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: Past guests, locals buying gifts, followers who have not booked yet
briefDefaults.hook: A verified number or a dated offer
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A verified proof number in the hook raises link clicks. Success: link CTR >= 1.5% of reach.

archetypes.name: Chef series (recurring persona format)
archetypes.useFor: A numbered series with the same opening and the chef as the recurring character: one dish or one gesture per episode, same rhythm every time.
archetypes.hookType: Series opener + episode number ('Dalla cucina di Giacomo, ep. 12') then one concrete promise.
narrative: hook: series title + episode number over the chef or his hands
3 beats on one dish or technique

platformAdaptations.instagram_reels: 9:16, 12-16 s, same cover style every episode so the grid reads as a series.
platformAdaptations.tiktok: same cut, series name in the caption, episode number first.
platformAdaptations.facebook: same reel, full caption without tags.

qualityGates: the chef or his hands must be in the hook photo
episode number must increase
texts describe what the photos show
add audio in-app at posting time or via reel.audio (Instagram downranks muted reels)

briefDefaults.audience: People who follow chefs and Sicilian food, locals and travellers planning Palermo
briefDefaults.objective: Follows and profile visits that turn into class bookings
briefDefaults.hook: Series title + episode number, then one promise
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A recurring series format earns more follows per play than one-off reels. Success: follows per 1,000 plays >= 5.

archetypes.name: The island (place first, then the table)
archetypes.useFor: Editorial piece about where the experience happens: Sicily, its sea and light, and then the table a private chef lays there. The kind of post a starred restaurant publishes about its land.
archetypes.hookType: One calm landscape of Sicily with the place and the month, nothing else.
narrative: the sea or the land once more
the house's table in that light
what the experience is, in one paragraph

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; cover full-bleed landscape, then matted slides.

qualityGates: a licensed picture is never presented as the house's own
the last photograph and at least two in all are the house's own
credits of licensed pictures in the caption

briefDefaults.audience: American travellers dreaming of and planning a stay in Sicily; guests of villas and boats around Palermo
briefDefaults.objective: Saves, sends and profile visits from people planning a stay
briefDefaults.hook: The island first: one landscape, the place and the month
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A piece that opens on the place earns more saves and sends than one that opens on a plate. Success: saves plus shares >= 3% of reach.

archetypes.name: The season (produce first, then the hands)
archetypes.useFor: Editorial piece about what the season gives in Sicily and what is made of it in the chef's kitchen during a class. Produce leads, the craft follows.
archetypes.hookType: One picture of produce at its best with the season named, nothing else.
narrative: cover: the produce of the season
the same produce in the kitchen
hands or the chef at work

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; cover full-bleed produce, then matted slides.

qualityGates: a licensed picture is never presented as the house's own or as produce bought for the guests
the last photograph and at least two in all are the house's own
credits of licensed pictures in the caption

briefDefaults.audience: American travellers who want to do something with their hands in Sicily, not only see it
briefDefaults.objective: Saves and profile visits that turn into class bookings
briefDefaults.hook: A feeling, not a service: for example "Don't just visit Sicily. Learn to make it." Produce of the season first.
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A piece that opens on the season's produce earns more saves than one that opens on the kitchen. Success: saves >= 2% of reach.

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; photographs fill the slide wherever they are large enough.

archetypes.name: The evening (the table first, then the island)
archetypes.useFor: A private dinner told as an evening: the house's best dish or table fills the cover, two more moments of the dinner follow, one picture of Sicily sets the place, then what the experience is.
archetypes.hookType: The house's strongest photograph, full page, with a line that gives a feeling the traveller wants.
narrative: cover: the dish or the table, one feeling
a second moment of the dinner
qualityGates: cover and last photograph are the house's own
no sentence twice
no bare course names

briefDefaults.audience: American couples, families and small groups planning Sicily, and guests of villas around Palermo
briefDefaults.objective: Sends to travel companions, then qualified quote requests
briefDefaults.hook: A feeling, not a service: for example "You came to Sicily for the food. Make it personal."
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A cover that gives a feeling earns more sends than one that names the service. Success: sends >= 1% of reach.

platformAdaptations.instagram_carousel: 4:5; photographs fill the slide wherever they are large enough.

archetypes.name: The craft (the hands first, then the season)
archetypes.useFor: The cooking class told as something the traveller takes home: the hands or the fresh pasta fill the cover, the season's produce sets the place, the finished dish closes.
archetypes.hookType: The house's strongest photograph of the making, full page, with a line about learning it oneself.
qualityGates: cover and last photograph are the house's own
no sentence twice
no bare course names

briefDefaults.audience: American travellers who want to do something with their hands in Sicily, not only see it
briefDefaults.objective: Sends to travel companions, then class bookings
briefDefaults.hook: A feeling, not a service: for example "Don't just visit Sicily. Learn to make it."
briefDefaults.cta: Request availability on risthome.it (link in bio)
briefDefaults.hypothesisTemplate: A cover about learning earns more sends than one about a dish. Success: sends >= 1% of reach.
